Working with a variety of multi\-functional teams, the Interactive Engineering group brings it all together to deliver the interactive experiences with an excellent group of software engineers while having fun along the way. This team is exciting and fast\-paced; it’s a great place for people with exacting standards who want their work to matter.  

We are looking for a Software Engineer with 3\+ years of experience to design, develop, and enhance modern, distributed, scalable, and high\-performance Content Management Systems (CMS) using Java, open\-source technologies, and modern software engineering practices. This role is critical to the evolution of Apple’s brand as you will be working with the teams taking apple.com to the next phase of its evolution. We are looking for engineers who are passionate about building modern CMS platforms, solving complex content management problems at scale, and leveraging AI\-assisted engineering and agentic workflows to improve both CMS capabilities and software development productivity.  

  

**Description**  

This role provides an opportunity to build modern, distributed, and large\-scale Content Management Systems that power apple.com and enable content to be created, managed, governed, and delivered across multiple digital experiences.  

You will work across Java backend services, CMS platforms, content architecture, content modeling, workflows, APIs, integrations, search, distributed systems, cloud technologies, and AI\-powered engineering workflows.  

The role is suited for an engineer who enjoys solving complex CMS problems at scale and is excited about the evolution of CMS platforms through headless architectures, open\-source technologies, automation, and AI agents.  

The primary focus of this role is CMS engineering.","responsibilities":"Design, develop, customize, and extend the distributed, large\-scale CMS platforms that power apple.com and other Apple digital experiences, supporting high volumes of content.  

Build and enhance capabilities across the content lifecycle, including content creation, modeling, relationships, metadata, taxonomy, workflows, approvals, versioning, localization, publishing, and delivery.  

Work hands\-on with Java\-based open\-source CMS platforms and frameworks and extend their capabilities to meet evolving product and business requirements.  

Design and develop headless and API\-first CMS solutions enabling content delivery across web, mobile, and other digital channels.  

Develop and integrate REST and GraphQL APIs for content authoring, management, preview, search, and delivery using Java and Spring Boot.  

Build integrations between CMS platforms and search, digital asset management, identity, analytics, CDN, and other enterprise systems.  

Design solutions for scalability, high availability, resiliency, fault tolerance, and efficient content delivery in distributed environments.  

Implement caching, indexing, asynchronous processing, and event\-driven mechanisms for large\-scale CMS workloads.  

Work with databases and data models supporting large content repositories and efficient content retrieval.  

Develop and maintain supporting backend services and microservices in Java, using Spring Boot and related frameworks, based on the CMS architecture.  

Deploy and operate CMS services using Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms.  

Troubleshoot and resolve CMS, performance, scalability, integration, and production issues, including JVM\-level performance and memory tuning.  

Develop unit, integration, and API tests using JUnit and related Java testing frameworks, and contribute to CI/CD and engineering automation.  

Participate in technical design discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement of the CMS platform.  

Leverage AI coding assistants and AI agents to improve development productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and engineering workflows.  

Explore and build AI\-powered capabilities and agentic workflows for CMS use cases, where appropriate.  

Collaborate with product managers, architects, frontend engineers, DevOps teams, and content stakeholders.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

Hands\-on experience with Java\-based CMS or content platforms and their extension APIs.  

Experience with DAM or PIM solutions and integrations supporting content\-as\-a\-service at scale.  

Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms for deploying JVM services.  

Experience with caching and search technologies such as Redis, Memcached, Elasticsearch, or Solr.  

Experience with event\-driven architectures using Kafka or similar messaging systems.  

Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks (React / Vue / Angular) for CMS authoring interfaces.  

Hands\-on experience using AI/ML tools and AI coding assistants to accelerate development, testing, and operational excellence.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

3\+ years of professional software development experience building scalable, highly available backend and web applications in Java.  

Hands\-on experience with Java (Java 11 or later) and the Spring / Spring Boot ecosystem, including dependency injection, Spring MVC, and Spring Data.  

A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience, with a focus on fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented design.  

Experience designing and developing RESTful and/or GraphQL web services in Java.  

Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases and data modeling for content\-heavy applications.  

Experience with Java build and CI/CD tooling such as Maven or Gradle, Git, and Jenkins.  

Experience writing unit and integration tests with JUnit, Mockito, or similar frameworks.

title: Senior Network HW System Engineer
description:
**Overview**  

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for passionate engineers to help achieve that mission.


Microsoft's Hardware Systems organization is developing AI\-native silicon and system\-level solutions to power the next generation of frontier AI models. The MAIA platform combines custom accelerators, advanced networking technologies, large\-scale distributed infrastructure, and cloud\-scale software to deliver industry\-leading AI training and inference capabilities.


The Platform Systems Engineering (PSE) team is seeking a AI Network HW Systems Engineer to drive the architecture, bring\-up, validation, optimization, and deployment of networking infrastructure for next\-generation MAIA AI systems. This role sits at the intersection of networking hardware, systems architecture, AI infrastructure, and hyperscale deployment.


You will work across the entire networking stack, from high\-speed SerDes interfaces, optics, cables, NICs, PHYs, and switch silicon to AI communication frameworks and distributed training workloads. You will collaborate with architects, silicon engineers, firmware developers, hardware designers, validation teams, OS developers, manufacturing partners, and Azure service teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and high\-performance AI networking solutions.


This is a unique opportunity to influence the future of AI infrastructure while enabling Microsoft's next generation of frontier\-scale AI systems.

  

\#azure \#MAIA \#AI/ML \#Networking Hardware

 **Responsibilities**  

AI Networking Architecture \& Platform Development

* Define and drive networking architectures for MAIA AI training and inference platforms, spanning scale\-up and scale\-out deployments. Partner across architecture, silicon, firmware, software, and Azure infrastructure teams to deliver networking solutions from concept through datacenter deployment while influencing future networking roadmaps.

Network Hardware Integration \& System Bring\-Up

* Lead the integration, bring\-up, and deployment of network hardware technologies including switches, NICs, PHYs, high\-speed SerDes interfaces, optics, cables, and backplane solutions. Collaborate with internal teams, ODMs, and technology partners to ensure successful qualification and production readiness.

AI Fabric Validation, Performance \& Reliability

* Define and execute validation strategies for AI networking infrastructure, including functional, performance, scale, interoperability, reliability, and stress testing. Develop automated qualification frameworks and methodologies to ensure robust operation in rack\-scale and cluster\-scale AI environments.

Performance Optimization \& Networking Efficiency

* Analyze and optimize AI fabric performance across distributed training and inference workloads. Evaluate latency, bandwidth utilization, congestion behavior, and collective communication efficiency, translating workload requirements into scalable networking solutions and architecture recommendations.

High\-Speed Interconnect \& Emerging Technologies

* Drive qualification and deployment of next\-generation networking technologies, including high\-speed copper and optical interconnects, PAM4\-based SerDes, advanced optics, and future networking innovations such as LPO, LRO, CPO, and silicon photonics. Evaluate technology tradeoffs across performance, power, reliability, and scalability.

Debug, Telemetry \& Automation

* Lead root\-cause analysis of networking and AI fabric issues spanning physical layer, network protocols, and distributed AI communication layers. Develop telemetry, diagnostics, automation, and fleet monitoring solutions that improve network reliability, accelerate issue resolution, and enhance engineering productivity.
  

Key Responsibilities

* Drive end\-to\-end architecture, integration, validation, and deployment of networking infrastructure for MAIA AI systems across scale\-up and scale\-out environments.
* Partner with silicon, firmware, software, hardware, and Azure infrastructure teams to define networking requirements and deliver scalable, reliable, and high\-performance AI fabrics.
* Lead bring\-up, qualification, and optimization of network subsystems including switches, NICs, PHYs, optics, cables, and high\-speed SerDes technologies.
* Develop validation and performance methodologies for AI networking infrastructure, ensuring readiness across functionality, scale, reliability, and stress conditions.
* Drive root\-cause analysis, telemetry, and automation solutions to improve network resiliency, operational efficiency, and fleet health.
* Evaluate and influence next\-generation networking technologies and architectures required to support future AI workloads and hyperscale deployments.
 **Qualifications**  

Preferred Qualifications


AI Infrastructure Experience

* Experience developing GPU, FPGA, TPU, AI accelerator, or HPC\-based systems.
* Familiarity with AI workload communication patterns and collective operations.
* Understanding of large\-scale distributed AI training environments.

Optical \& Interconnect Expertise


Deep knowledge of:

* Optical transceivers (DR4, DR8, FR4\)
* DSP architectures
* TIAs and drivers
* Optical link budgets
* OMA, TDECQ, receiver sensitivity analysis
* Silicon photonics technologies
* Co\-packaged optics architectures

Industry Standards


Experience with:

* IEEE Ethernet standards
* OIF specifications
* CMIS management frameworks
* Ultra Ethernet Consortium technologies
* Future 224G and 448G ecosystems

Datacenter \& Manufacturing

* Experience with hyperscale datacenter deployments.
* Knowledge of ODM, CM, and supplier ecosystems.
* Experience managing products through EVT, DVT, PVT, and production ramps.

Software \& Automation

* Experience with Linux environments and automation frameworks.
* Background developing telemetry, diagnostics, validation, and qualification tooling.
* Familiarity with scripting and data analysis environments.
  

  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Overall Solution Ownership

Design and position agentic AI capabilities — LLM\-powered virtual agents, autonomous remediation bots, and AI — integrated into service desk workflows.
  
Build self\-service and contact\-deflection strategies targeting measurable reductions in contact volume and mean\-time\-to\-resolve (MTTR).
  
Establish guardrails, audit trails, and feedback loops to ensure agentic solutions are safe, explainable, and continuously improving.
  
Ways of Working \& Operating Model
  
Champion shift\-left, knowledge\-centered service (KCS), and DevOps practices within service desk solution designs.
  
Define tiering, routing, and escalation models that balance cost\-to\-serve with user experience outcomes.
  
Establish SLA/XLA frameworks and a metrics hierarchy that connects team activities to measurable business outcomes.
  
Platform \& Tooling
  
Deep understanding of ITSM and ITAM tooling, and the integrations between the service desk platform and adjacent systems: CMDB, identity, endpoint management, observability, and enterprise applications.
  
Leadership \& Stakeholder Engagement
  
Serve as trusted advisor to client CxOs on service desk strategy, technology investment, and transformation direction.
  
Translate complex architecture concepts into compelling business narratives for senior executives and non\-technical sponsors.
  
Mentor and develop junior and mid\-level architects within the service desk practice
  
Qualifications \& Experience
  
Experience
  
15\+ years in IT service management \& service desk roles, in a solution or enterprise architecture capacity.
  
Proven track record designing and delivering large\-scale ITSM platform transformations in complex, multi\-geography organisations.
  
Demonstrable hands\-on experience architecting automation and AI solutions in live service desk environments
  
Exposure to managed service provider (MSP) models, outsourcing deal structures, and sourcing strategy is required.
  
Track record of senior client\-facing leadership — credibly engaging and influencing CxO, Board, and Procurement stakeholders in competitive pursuit scenarios.
  
Technical Depth
  
**ITSM platforms:** like ServiceNow (preferred), Jira Service Management
  
**Automation \& workflow:** like UiPath, Ansible, ServiceNow Flow Designer, Power Automate.
  
**Agentic \& AI:** LLM orchestration, RAG architecture
  
**Observability \& AIOps:** like Dynatrace, Datadog, Splunk — event correlation and intelligent alerting.
  
**Contact Centre:** like AWS Connect, Genesys — architecture and integration into ITSM workflows.
  
**Language \& communication tooling:** like Krisp\+ and equivalent real\-time translation/transcription platforms
  
Frameworks \& Certifications
  
ITIL 4 Foundation or higher.
  
**Architecture certifications:** AWS / Microsoft / GCP Solutions Architect advantageous.
  
Behaviours \& Soft Skills
  
Strategic thinker who can zoom in to debug a workflow and zoom out to present a 3\-year vision.
  
Location
  
Flexible / Any hub location. Willingness to travel for client meetings and operate across global time zones expected.
  
  

Overview
  
The Service Desk Solution Architect is a senior client facing role responsible for shaping and owning end to end ITSM and service desk solutions across large, commercially complex outsourcing and transformation engagements. Should be capable to lead 40M pursuits acting as the primary technical authority who translates client business problems into differentiated, AI powered service desk solutions.
  
The individual brings deep expertise across the ITSM platform landscape, automation tooling, agentic AI, and modern service desk ways of working. Can define solution strategy, shaping operating models, and building compelling business cases that resonate at CxO level.
  
The role demands a high calibre blend of technical and commercial capability owning the solution blueprint and roadmap, driving self service and deflection strategies, and transitioning winning solutions into delivery with full operational credibility. The individual will work across sales pursuit teams, delivery, commercial, and client stakeholders and will be a visible leader both internally and in the market.

title: Associate Technical Architect
description:
While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth.  

  

If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you\- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi!

**Role Summary**
----------------


We are looking for a Associate Architect *SD who* has led a team and who uses generative AI heavily to deliver day\-to\-day engineering work.


This is a builder's role with an architect's habits. You will own problems from the vague first description through to something running in production, and you will do it by directing AI rather than by typing every line yourself. You will work closely with the Tech Architect as a thinking partner across product and engineering.

**What You Should Know**
------------------------

### **Working with AI (mandatory)**


This is the part we will not compromise on. You should be able to point to real delivery, not experiments or weekend reading.

* **Spec\-driven development.** You have worked from a written spec that an agent executes against. Frameworks such as GSD, BMAD or SpecKit, or an equivalent approach your team built in\-house.
* **Harness engineering.** Hands\-on with an agent harness such as Claude Code, Kiro or GitHub Copilot. You have configured and shaped one, not only typed into it.
* **Sub\-agents.** You understand how to split work across agents, and where that helps and where it makes things worse.
* **Skills and custom agents.** You have built reusable skills or custom agents for your own workflow rather than using only what came out of the box.
* **Judgment about all of the above.** You know where these methods break down, because you have hit it.


Good to have, and worth telling us about: context and token efficiency, evaluating agent output at scale, cost control, or your own tooling built on top of a harness. This field moves faster than any list we can write, so if you have gone further than the bullets above, say where.

### **Engineering breadth**


We care about range more than depth in any single technology.

* Comfortable across layers: frontend behaviour, backend services and API design, and how data is modelled and stored.
* React, TypeScript, Node, Python, relational and document databases are the kind of ground we work on. You should be able to operate on most of it.
* Able to hold an architecture discussion and design a system, rather than recall framework specifics.

### **Cloud and delivery**

* Hands\-on with a major cloud provider, AWS or GCP.
* Comfortable with Docker.
* Able to set up CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment.
* Familiar with logging and observability tooling.

**Experience Required**
-----------------------


All three are required. If you do not meet all three, this is not the right role for you right now.

 **At least five years building software professionally.**

**You have led a team.** Formal reports or a tech lead role with no reporting line both count. What matters is that you have actually led, not what the title said.

**You have worked across layers, not inside one.** We are not looking for a specialist in a single part of the stack.

**What You Will Own**
---------------------

### **End\-to\-end delivery**


Take a problem from first description to delivered feature. Turn vague requirements into a technical plan, and surface risks and trade\-offs while they are still cheap to act on.


You drive that delivery with generative AI. Spec\-driven development and agent harnesses are how the work gets done here, not a side experiment.

### **Architecture thinking**


Hold the architecture in your head: how the frontend, the services and the data layer fit together, and where each will strain.


You need that so you can work with an agent to reach the right design, review what it proposes, and catch the choice that will hurt in six months. You are not expected to hand\-build every layer yourself.

### **Technical and product judgment**


You have built real software before, and it shows in the questions you ask. An agent will happily produce code that works on a clean slate, and most of our work is not a clean slate. Reading an existing system, understanding why it is shaped the way it is, and changing it without breaking things is the job.


You should also be able to tell where AI genuinely belongs in a product and where it does not, with a working sense of the cost, latency and failure modes involved.

### **Quality and production readiness**


You set the standard for what ships. When most of the code is agent\-written, the skill is not typing it cleanly. It is knowing what good looks like and catching what is wrong in review.

### **Working with people**


You work closely with the Tech Architect, product managers and other engineers. You raise blockers early and bring options with them.

**When You Apply**
------------------


Be ready to walk us through one feature you shipped where an agent wrote most of the code: what you specified up front, what came back wrong, and what you had to fix yourself.


Link a pull request or repository if the work is public. Most of this work sits behind a company firewall, and that counts against you not at all.

**Why This Role Is Different**
------------------------------


This is not a traditional full\-stack engineering job, and the difference is not cosmetic.


The engineers who do well here think in user journeys, systems and outcomes rather than tickets. They own problems rather than tasks. And they treat AI as the way the work gets done, not as a tool they occasionally reach for.


If that describes how you already work, this will feel like the obvious next role. If it does not, it will be a frustrating one.

*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us**!*

title: ASIC Verification Engineer (IP & SoC)
description:
Overview:
We are seeking a highly skilled **ASIC Verification Engineer (IP \& SoC)** with 5 to 10 years of hands\-on experience in semiconductor verification. The ideal candidate will be responsible for defining and executing verification strategies for complex IPs and SoCs, developing scalable UVM\-based verification environments, and validating high\-speed protocols such as AMBA AXI and PCIe. This role requires strong debugging expertise, automation skills, and experience working with industry\-standard EDA verification tools.
Responsibilities:
### **Verification Planning \& Execution**

* Define, develop, and execute comprehensive verification plans at both IP and SoC levels.
* Drive verification closure through functional coverage, code coverage, assertions, and regression analysis.
* Develop verification methodologies aligned with project requirements and quality standards.

### **Testbench Architecture \& Development**

* Architect and develop scalable, reusable constrained\-random verification environments using **SystemVerilog and UVM**.
* Create verification components, scoreboards, monitors, checkers, and reusable testbench infrastructure.
* Develop and execute directed, random, and stress test scenarios.

### **AMBA AXI Verification**

* Verify and validate **AXI3, AXI4, and AXI5** based subsystems.
* Validate AXI Interconnects, NoCs (Network\-on\-Chip), and multi\-layer bus architectures.
* Analyze and verify out\-of\-order transaction handling, latency optimization, and bandwidth performance.

### **PCIe Sub\-System Verification**

* Verify PCIe Gen3, Gen4, Gen5, and Gen6 controller functionality across Physical, Data Link, and Transaction Layers.
* Validate high\-performance DMA engines operating in Endpoint and Root Complex configurations.
* Ensure protocol compliance and robust performance under various traffic conditions.

### **Protocol \& Performance Verification**

* Verify high\-speed industry\-standard protocols and ensure compliance with protocol specifications.
* Execute performance verification to validate throughput, latency, and system\-level behavior.
* Support low\-power verification methodologies using UPF/CPF where applicable.

### **Debugging \& Failure Analysis**

* Debug complex simulation failures and identify root causes in RTL designs.
* Perform protocol\-level debugging and waveform analysis.
* Collaborate closely with design, architecture, and software teams to resolve issues efficiently.

### **Gate\-Level Simulation (GLS)**

* Set up and execute gate\-level simulations with and without timing annotations.
* Analyze timing\-related issues and support pre\-silicon signoff activities.

### **Automation \& Productivity Enhancement**

* Develop automation scripts using Python, Perl, or Tcl.
* Improve regression execution, result analysis, coverage tracking, and verification workflows.

Requirements:
### **Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Communication Engineering, VLSI, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

### **Experience**

* 5 to 10 years of proven experience in ASIC/SoC verification.
* Strong background in IP\-level and SoC\-level verification projects.

### **Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in **SystemVerilog and UVM**.
* Hands\-on experience with constrained\-random verification methodologies.
* Solid understanding of AMBA AXI protocols (AXI3/4/5\).
* Experience in verifying PCIe Gen3/4/5/6 subsystems.
* Knowledge of Network\-on\-Chip (NoC), interconnect architectures, and DMA engines.
* Experience with protocol compliance, functional coverage, assertions, and verification closure.

### **Low Power \& Performance Verification**

* Experience with low\-power verification using **UPF/CPF** (preferred).
* Understanding of performance verification techniques and system\-level analysis.

### **Automation Skills**

* Proficiency in scripting using **Python, Perl, or Tcl**.
* Experience automating verification and regression environments.

### **EDA Tools**


Hands\-on experience with one or more industry\-standard simulators:

* Synopsys VCS
* Cadence Xcelium
* Siemens Questa/QuestaSim

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with gate\-level simulations and timing analysis.
* Exposure to advanced verification methodologies and reusable verification IPs.
* Strong debugging, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced product development environment.

title: Senior Staff Software Architect
description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================


As a Senior Staff Software Architect, you will define and evolve the architecture of Cardiology platform based on embedded software used across multiple products. This role requires strong architectural ownership beyond individual component development, with experience scaling design systems.
  

  

The ideal candidate should combine strong architecture, governance, performance engineering, quality strategy, technical leadership, and practical AI\-assisted engineering experience.  

  

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world\-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.**Job Description**
===================


We are in a phase of growth, designing next generation Cardiology devices. This requires an architect who thinks like a platform owner, not just a component builder. You must look beyond individual implementation details to think about scale, governance, and empowerment. You will define the architectural foundations and self\-service patterns that let teams move fast without breaking the consistency, compatibility, and accessibility standards required for patient safety.

**Core Responsibilities:**

**1\. Architecture \& Platform Design**

* **Platform Architecture:** Define and evolve scalable architecture for embedded system.

**2\. Quality, Performance \& Technical Debt**

* **Quality Strategy:** Define quality strategy across unit, component, regression, integration, and E2E testing. Establish release\-blocking quality gates and compatibility expectations.
* **Performance Engineering:** Diagnose and improve rendering, memory, bundle\-size, and framework\-integration performance. Define measurable performance baselines, and engineering health metrics rather than subjective assessments.
* **Debt Prioritization:** Prioritize technical and QA debt based on customer impact, adoption, risk, and maintainability.

**3\. Roadmap**

* **Architecture Roadmap:** Create architecture roadmaps and guide long\-term evolution without unnecessary rewrites, aligning with product priorities.
* **Cross\-Functional Partnership:** Partner with Leadership, Product, UX, QA, DevOps, and engineering teams to drive architecture decisions across organizational boundaries.

**Core Competencies:**

Works closely with cross\-functional engineering, UX, and product teams to ensure alignment and secure buy\-in.
* **Architectural Ownership:** Acts as the clear architectural owner for Embedded System platform. Demonstrates cross\-team architectural ownership rather than experience limited to individual contributor delivery.
* **Applied AI for Development:** Uses AI\-assisted engineering for refactoring, testing, migrations, documentation, debugging, and code review. Understands model selection and context/token management. Can define safe team\-level AI development practices (validation, security, human\-review controls) and demonstrate measurable improvements in productivity.
* **Evidence\-Based Direction:** Challenges existing architecture when required and can demonstrate examples where technical direction was corrected based on evidence.

* Strong knowledge of Object\-Oriented Analysis and Design, Software Design Patterns and C\+\+ coding principles.

* Ensure compliance/closure of Regulatory and Quality requirements before approving Design Outputs/Program Deliverables
* Lead continuous improvement activities by driving the implementation of process and product quality improvement initiatives

* Bachelor's Degree / Masters in a relevant Engineering discipline (Electronics or Software is preferred)

title: Senior Architect (Data, Cloud, AI)
description:
About Ellucian:

Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students. Ellucian's AI\-powered platform, trained on the richest dataset available in higher education, drives efficiency, personalized experiences, and strengthened engagement for all students, faculty and staff. Fueled by decades of experience with a singular focus on the unique needs of learning institutions, the Ellucian platform features best\-in\-class SaaS capabilities and delivers insights needed now and into the future. These solutions and services span the entire student lifecycle, including data\-rich tools for student recruitment, enrollment, and retention to workforce analytics, fundraising, and alumni engagement. Ellucian's innovative solutions, vast ecosystem of partners and user community of more than 45,000 provides best practices leading to greater institutional success and achieving better student outcomes.
About the Opportunity:

Ellucian is seeking a highly skilled and innovative Senior Architect to lead the architecture and technical strategy for our next\-generation Data Platform and analytics solution. This role will be instrumental in transforming our current data warehouse ecosystem into a modern, scalable, cloud\-native Lakehouse platform capable of supporting analytics, AI/ML workloads, agentic AI experiences, and real\-time data products.


This is a hands\-on architecture leadership role requiring deep expertise in data platforms, data warehouse, distributed systems, cloud technologies, and emerging AI technologies.


As a key technical leader , role offers opportunities to spearhead technical initiatives, mentor engineers at all levels, and work closely with internal product managers, experienced engineers, and cross\-functional teams to design, develop, test, and deliver advanced features that enhance student success and drive higher education transformation.

**Where You Will Make an Impact**

**Architecture \& Strategy**

* Build and own the target\-state architecture for a next\-generation Lakehouse platform.
* Develop technology roadmaps aligned with business strategy and product vision.
* Lead architectural decisions across data ingestion, storage, processing, governance, observability, security, and AI enablement.
* Establish architecture principles, standards, and reference architectures.

**Platform Modernization**

* Lead migration from traditional data warehouse architectures to modern Lakehouse architectures.
* Design scalable data platforms supporting structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data.
* Evaluate and drive adoption of technologies such as Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Apache Spark, DuckDB, Trino, Flink, Kafka, and cloud\-native analytics services.
* Design multi\-tenant SaaS architectures with strong security and data isolation.

**AI \& Intelligent Data Platform**

* Define architecture patterns enabling AI\-powered data experiences.
* Design platforms supporting:
* + Generative AI applications
	+ Agentic AI workflows
	+ Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)
	+ Vector databases and semantic search
	+ AI\-assisted analytics and insights
* Partner with AI teams to operationalize ML and GenAI workloads.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine applicability to the platform roadmap.

**Technical Leadership**

* Take ownership of critical tasks from specification review through final testing and deployment, ensuring timely and high\-quality delivery.
* Serve as the highest level technical authority for the platform.
* Mentor architects and senior engineers.
* Conduct architecture reviews and guide critical design decisions.
* Drive engineering excellence and technical innovation across teams.

**Scalability, Reliability \& Operations**

* Architect for high availability, performance, resiliency, and cost optimization.
* Define observability and operational excellence standards.
* Drive platform reliability through automation and SRE practices.
* Establish governance around performance, security, compliance, and data quality.

**What You Will Bring**

* **Experience**: Bachelor / Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, AI, or related field. Overall 15\+ years of software engineering exp with 7\+ years of professional software development experience in a product or SaaS environment building modern Data platform.
* Deep expertise in modern data architectures including Data warehouse, Data Mesh, Data platforms.
* Deep expertise in distributed data processing frameworks, Apache Spark, Trino, Flink, Kafka.
* Experience with open table formats, Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake.

  

* Strong understanding of Metadata management, Lineage, observability.
* **Distributed Systems**: Experience designing, building, and evolving large\-scale distributed systems, microservices, event\-driven architectures, and highly available production services.
* **Cloud and Platform Engineering**: Strong knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, containerization, infrastructure automation, and modern operational practices for reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* **Engineering Excellence**: Deep experience with CI/CD, code review, test automation, observability, release engineering, and DevOps practices in modern software delivery environments.
* **Security and Risk Awareness**: Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, encryption, secure design, and practical application security principles in enterprise software.
* **LLM and Agentic Systems Experience**: Demonstrated experience building or guiding solutions that use large language models, including agent\-based workflows, prompt and context design, tool orchestration, structured outputs, and human\-in\-the\-loop validation patterns.
* **Model Selection and Evaluation**: Experience working with multiple LLMs or AI providers and making practical tradeoff decisions across model quality, latency, cost, reliability, safety, and enterprise suitability.
* **AI Engineering Practices**: Understanding of core patterns for production AI systems such as retrieval\-augmented generation, evaluation frameworks, observability, prompt management, guardrails, fallback strategies, and secure handling of sensitive data.
* **Judgment and Governance**: Ability to evaluate AI\-generated output critically, define validation standards, identify risk areas, and maintain human accountability for technical decisions and delivered outcomes.
* **Technical Communication**: Excellent communication, collaboration, and organizational skills, with the ability to align engineers, product partners, and stakeholders around technical direction and execution tradeoffs.
* **Mentorship and Influence**: Proven experience mentoring engineers, leading technical discussions, raising engineering standards, and shaping development practices across a team or organization.

* Lead time

* Defining clear usage guidelines, patterns, and documentation
* Monitoring and improving core platform

* Documentation and developer onboarding
* Feedback loops to continuously improve the platform

* Define support and development, including issue triage, resolution timelines, and escalation paths for consuming teams.


**Platform Adoption \& Engineering Metrics**


* Define and track success metrics for platform, including:
* Developer onboarding time and productivity
* Defect trends and issue resolution timelines
* Use insights from usage and feedback to drive **continuous improvement of the platform**.

title: Configuration Specialist
description:
**Purpose (of the role):**


The Configuration Specialist operates within a structured, scalable delivery model focused on executing well\-defined configuration activities through a centralised intake process (e.g. ServiceNow). Work items are assigned with detailed requirements, contextual information, and predefined standards via structured request forms, enabling consistent, high\-quality delivery at scale.


This role is responsible for accurately executing repeatable, process\-driven tasks using established methodologies, documentation, and configuration standards. The Specialist applies attention to detail and discipline to ensure outputs are reliable, traceable, and aligned with global best practices.


Operating as part of a global delivery capability, the role emphasises efficiency, consistency, and continuous improvement. There is no direct client engagement; instead, the focus is on dependable execution, effective use of tooling (including AI\-assisted capabilities), and contribution to reusable knowledge assets such as the Services Catalogue.

**Clinisys' AI Philosophy**


Building an **AI‑first organisation** is central to Clinisys’ purpose and the impact we deliver. As a global provider of intelligent diagnostic informatics solutions, we build AI‑enabled, cloud‑based platforms to enhance diagnostic workflows across healthcare, life sciences, and public health. By applying intelligent technology thoughtfully and responsibly, we help laboratories and testing environments operate more effectively, generate meaningful insights at scale, and ultimately support healthier and safer communities. Operating across more than 30 countries, Clinisys expects all colleagues—regardless of role or function—to work confidently with AI‑enabled tools, apply digital and analytical thinking, and continuously adapt as technologies evolve. We **must drive an AI\-first sense of purpose and urgency.**

**Job Summary:**


1\. **Essential Functions / Job Responsibilities**

* Execute configuration tasks assigned through structured intake systems (e.g. ServiceNow), ensuring full adherence to the instructions, context, and acceptance criteria provided within each request.
* Interpret and apply detailed work instructions, templates, and supporting documentation to deliver consistent, high\-quality outcomes across repeatable configuration activities.
* Operate within a process\-driven delivery framework, ensuring tasks are completed efficiently, accurately, and in alignment with defined service levels and quality benchmarks.
* Follow established escalation pathways when task inputs, requirements, or instructions are unclear or incomplete, ensuring risks to quality or timelines are proactively managed.
* Maintain a strong focus on consistency and standardisation by adhering strictly to configuration standards, governance frameworks, and catalogue\-defined approaches.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of intake quality by identifying gaps, ambiguities, or inefficiencies in task instructions and providing structured feedback to upstream roles (e.g. Configuration Architects, intake reviewers).
* Develop and maintain configuration artefacts within the Services Catalogue, ensuring outputs are reusable, well\-documented, and aligned to standard patterns.
* Leverage AI\-assisted tools and automation capabilities, where approved, to increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve accuracy across repetitive tasks.
* Ensure all configuration activities are fully documented, version\-controlled, and traceable in line with governance and audit requirements.
* Collaborate with global teams in a structured manner to support throughput and workload balancing, without direct client interaction.


2\. **Skills needed to be successful**

* Knowledge of configuration management principles, tools, and implementation practices within enterprise software environments.
* Understanding of AI\-assisted tools for configuration, documentation, and automation, with awareness of secure and compliant usage.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills with the ability to interpret requirements and translate them into effective configurations.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and concisely to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Proficiency in configuration tools and familiarity with scripting or automation platforms.
* Ability to leverage AI tools to support documentation, configuration standardisation, and knowledge management.
* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across cross\-functional and global teams.
* High attention to detail with strong documentation and quality assurance capabilities.


3\. **Required Experience \& Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
* Experience in configuration management, software implementation, or related technical roles.
* Familiarity with enterprise software solutions and configuration\-driven implementations.
* Exposure to automation tools, scripting, or AI\-assisted development environments is desirable.
* Ability to work in a structured, process\-driven environment with strong adherence to standards and governance.


4\. **Preferred Experience \& Education**

* Experience with Clinisys solutions or similar healthcare/LIMS platforms.
* Exposure to AI tools (e.g., Copilot or similar) for documentation, configuration, or automation tasks.
* Experience in building or maintaining reusable catalogues, templates, or configuration repositories.
* Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and global delivery models.
* Strong focus on continuous improvement, standardization, and operational efficiency.


5\. **Supervisory Responsibilities**


None

**Shift Timings:**

* This is a permanent role comprising a five\-day week with shifts to cover our US and UK hours from Monday to Friday. For India these are UK shifts from 1:00 PM to 10:00 PM IST.

*We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.*

title: Unified Data Platform Architect
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.


Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.


Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.


About the Role
  

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to provide technical leadership for the design and evolution of large\-scale data platforms and distributed systems.
  

This is a senior individual contributor role with responsibility for solving complex, ambiguous engineering problems and establishing technical direction across multiple systems and teams. You will architect platforms that process and serve data at significant scale, combining large\-scale batch and streaming computation with reliable backend services and cloud\-native infrastructure.
  

The ideal candidate has deep expertise in distributed systems and data infrastructure, with strong hands\-on experience in **Java, Hadoop, Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Apache Airflow, and Kubernetes**. Python experience is also important for data processing, platform automation, and engineering productivity.
  

You will remain technically hands\-on while influencing architecture, engineering standards, and long\-term platform strategy across the organization.
  

Responsibilities
* Define the architecture and long\-term technical direction for large\-scale data platforms and distributed processing systems.
* Lead the design of highly scalable, reliable backend and data infrastructure supporting business\-critical workloads.
* Architect and build high\-performance backend services and platform components primarily in **Java**, with **Python** used where appropriate for data processing, orchestration, automation, and tooling.
* Design and evolve large\-scale **batch and real\-time data processing architectures** using Apache Spark and Apache Flink.
* Establish architectural patterns for data ingestion, transformation, computation, orchestration, storage, and serving across the data lifecycle.
* Design reliable workflow and dependency\-management capabilities using **Apache Airflow** and related orchestration technologies.
* Define architecture and operational patterns for running large\-scale data and backend workloads on **Kubernetes**.
* Solve complex distributed\-systems challenges involving scalability, state management, fault tolerance, consistency, partitioning, backpressure, resource management, and recovery.
* Drive improvements in platform reliability, performance, observability, developer productivity, and infrastructure efficiency.
* Identify systemic bottlenecks and lead architectural initiatives that improve throughput, latency, availability, and cost at scale.
* Establish technical standards and reusable platform capabilities that enable multiple engineering and data teams.
* Lead architecture reviews and provide technical guidance for high\-impact initiatives spanning multiple systems and organizational boundaries.
* Partner with architects, senior engineers, engineering leaders, product teams, data engineers, and infrastructure teams to translate business requirements into long\-term technical strategy.
* Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, technical guidance, and engineering best practices.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and make strategic build\-versus\-buy and architectural decisions for the data platform.
* Lead complex migrations and modernization initiatives while maintaining production reliability and minimizing disruption to dependent systems.

Minimum Qualifications
* 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience designing and operating large\-scale distributed systems or data platforms.
* Deep expertise in **Java** and strong software engineering fundamentals.
* Proficiency with **Python** for data engineering, automation, or platform development.
* Extensive experience designing and building production backend services and distributed systems.
* Deep hands\-on experience with **Apache Spark** and large\-scale distributed data processing.
* Strong experience with the **Hadoop ecosystem**, including technologies such as HDFS, Hive, and YARN.
* Experience designing and operating real\-time or stateful streaming systems using **Apache Flink**.
* Experience designing large\-scale workflow orchestration using **Apache Airflow** or comparable technologies.
* Strong production experience with **Kubernetes**, containers, and cloud\-native application architectures.
* Deep understanding of distributed\-systems concepts including partitioning, replication, consistency, fault tolerance, distributed state, scheduling, resource management, and failure recovery.
* Strong understanding of both batch and streaming architectures and the tradeoffs between different processing models.
* Demonstrated experience driving architecture and technical decisions across multiple teams or major platform initiatives.
* Proven ability to operate effectively in ambiguous problem spaces and turn broad business or platform requirements into executable technical strategies.
* Track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering practices beyond an immediate team.

Preferred Qualifications
* Experience architecting platforms processing **petabyte\-scale datasets and/or billions of events per day**.
* Deep knowledge of **Apache Spark** and **Apache Flink**.

title: Software Architect - AUTOSAR
description:
- **Software Architect \- AUTOSAR**

Help shape the future of mobility.


Imagine a world with zero vehicle accidents, zero vehicle emissions, and wireless vehicle connectivity all around us. Every day, we move closer to making that world a reality. Aptiv’s passionate team of engineers and developers creates advanced safety systems, high\-performance electrification solutions and data connectivity solutions so that automakers can bring advanced capabilities to more people around the globe. This is how we enable sustainable mobility and help to prevent accidents caused by human error.


**Your Role**


	* Design, develop, and maintain embedded software solutions for automotive applications, leveraging expertise in embedded systems and real\-time operating systems (RTOS)
	* Implement automotive communication protocols and integrate software modules with microcontroller architectures to ensure seamless operation within vehicle systems
	* Integrate embedded software development activities into the automotive product development process, following established procedures and standards such as AUTOSAR and ASPICE
	* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define requirements, develop software architectures, and deliver high\-quality embedded software solutions in alignment with project objectives
	* Lead testing and debugging efforts for embedded software components, utilizing tools like Vector CANalyzer and CANoe to analyze communication protocols and verify system behavior
	* Manage embedded software requirements using tools like DOORS, ensuring traceability and alignment with project goals and customer needs
	* Document software design specifications, test plans, and validation reports to support the development and verification of embedded software solutions
	* Utilize version control systems such as Git and collaboration platforms like JIRA and Gerrit to manage software repositories and facilitate team collaboration
	* Ensure compliance with automotive product development processes and standards such as ASPICE, adhering to established guidelines and procedures throughout the software development lifecycle
	* Conduct code reviews, perform static analysis, and contribute to quality assurance activities to validate the integrity and safety of embedded software implementations**Your Background**

**Key ingredients for succeeding in this role are your:**


	* B.E. / B. Tech / M.E. / M. Tech in any specialization with an experience of 8\-15 years
	* Proficient in C and Microcontroller(S32, Aurix, Renesas), Experience working on Embedded/Autosar SW development
	* Analyze, interpret and clarify customer Autosar requirements
	* Deep expertise in more than two AUTOSAR BSW stack/MCAL modules\- com stack(CAN, Ethernet),Memory Stack, Diagnostic Stack, Cybersecurity Stack ,OS, Watchdog ,MCAL
	* Experience in CDD \& RTE, Experience on Vector/Mentor Autosar Tools
	* Experience on Autosar Multicore architecture. Understanding of 16/32\-bit microcontrollers
	* Experience with min one microcontroller architectures: Renesas RH family or TRICOR or PowerPC architecture
	* Expertise with development tolls: CANalyzer, debugger, oscilloscopes
	* Understanding and working experience on ASPICE and AGILE methodologies.
	* Functional Safety, Cyber Security**Why join us?**


	* You can grow at Aptiv. Aptiv provides an inclusive work environment where all individuals can grow and develop, regardless of gender, ethnicity or beliefs.
	* You can have an impact. Safety is a core Aptiv value; we want a safer world for us and our children, one with: Zero fatalities, Zero injuries, Zero accidents.
	* You have support. We ensure you have the resources and support you need to take care of your family and your physical and mental health with a competitive health insurance package.**Your Benefits at Aptiv:**


	* Flexible working hours;
	* Higher Education Opportunities (UDACITY, UDEMY, COURSERA are available for your continuous growth and development);
	* Life and accident insurance;
	* Sodexo cards for food and beverages;
	* Well Being Program that includes regular workshops and networking events;
	* EAP Employee Assistance;
	* Access to fitness clubs (T\&C apply);
	* Creche facility for working parents;Apply today, and together let’s change tomorrow!

description:

**Position Summary**

This position is part of our Advanced Safety \& User Experience segment.


As a System Engineer, you'll be at the forefront of developing next\-generation of Advance Safety and User Experience products.


In this role you will be responsible for ensuring that the products and technology meet customer and regulatory requirements. You will manage customer communication, requirements, and expectations throughout the product development lifecycle.


**Your Role**


	* Design, develop, and validate new products and technology
	* Ensure that system features and deliverables are completed on time per Aptiv quality standards
	* Follow APTIV design standards, guidelines, best practices, procedures and policies
	* Lead feature definition and requirement reviews
	* Ensure the logical and systematic transformation of requirements into a total system solution
	* Contribute to requirement analysis, system architecture, and feature integration / verification
	* Convert customer requirements into product requirements and design specification
	* Ensure proper development, execution and verification across all engineering competencies
	* Responsible to lead technical discussions, design reviews and customer presentations
	* Develop innovative and creative solutions to unique engineering challenges
	* Manage and track system features to ensure high quality delivery on\-time
	* Drive process, procedure, and methodology improvements to optimize and continuously improve work efficiency**Exp: 12\-16 yrs**

**Your Background**


	* Bachelor’s degree in engineering discipline (mechatronics, electrical, or related field of study)
	* 12\+ years professional experience in Consumer Electronics or Automotive Industry
	* Interpersonal skills, strong analytical skills, strong problem\-solving abilities, and a positive approach to challenge
	* Cross functional interests, ambitious and self\-driven. Adaptive, comfortable with ambiguity
	* Ability to effectively manage several projects at once
	* Strong soft skills: skilled networking creation, influencing skills, constantly learning, positive and ownership profile
	* Familiarity with Functional Safety or Cybersecurity knowledge/background
	* Familiarity with system development processes (Automotive SPICE) and tools
	* Experience with vehicle protocols and diagnostics
	* Experience with embedded hardware and serial communication tools
	* System Architecture knowledge.
	* Familiarity with ADAS ECU, Body Control Modules or similar.
	* Gather, analyze, and document business, customer, and system requirements, translating them into clear, testable specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
	* Collaborate with Product Management, Architects, Hardware, Software, and Validation teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
	* Drive requirements review, change management, traceability, and impact analysis.
	* Experience with vehicle communication protocols and diagnostics (CAN, LIN, Ethernet, UDS, etc.).**Nice to Haves (Preferred Qualifications):**


	* Master’s degree in engineering discipline (computer science, software, electrical, or related field of study)
	* Experience with low level drivers \- SPI, I2C, and/or Ethernet drivers
	* Experience working on global project
	* Experience working in an agile development team and with agile tools (e.g. JIRA, Confluence, etc.)**Why join Aptiv**


	* **You grow at Aptiv.**Aptiv's winning culture is global by design. We bring together diverse perspectives, cultures, and business contexts to solve our customers' toughest challenges. In this environment, every individual can grow, lead, and make an impact, regardless of background, because inclusion fuels how we innovate and win.


**You make an impact at Aptiv.**

One of the strengths of humanity is our drive to progress, to improve, to achieve more tomorrow than we did yesterday. People need solutions they can trust when it matters most. At Aptiv, you are building those solutions every day.


**You have support at Aptiv.**

We ensure you have the resources and support you need to take care of your family, your physical health, and your mental health with a competitive benefits package.


**Your Benefits at Aptiv:**


	* Higher Education Opportunities (UDACITY, UDEMY, COURSERA are available for your continuous growth and development);
	* Life and accident insurance;
	* Well Being Program that includes regular workshops and networking events;
	* EAP Employee Assistance.
	* Access to fitness clubs (T\&C apply);
	* Shift allowances are applicable. Will discuss during the interview process.**Meet the next generation Aptiv**

**At Aptiv, we deliver innovative solutions that people trust when it matters most.**

Progress is never static. It is about reaching further, exploring new possibilities, and enabling mobility. Aptiv empowers customers to create solutions people rely on—advancing safety and autonomy in Automotive and Commercial Vehicles, enabling mission\-critical performance in Aerospace \& Defense, and powering intelligent systems across Energy, Enterprise, and Telecommunications. We also drive precision and efficiency in Industrials \& Robotics and support life\-critical innovation in Medical technologies.


Guided by our winning culture and values to Think \& Act Like Owners, as One Team, and Play to Win, we turn commitment into results and achieve more together.  



**Join Us to Deliver Innovative Solutions That People Trust!**
